summary: This document outlines the requirements for training a Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent to play Ms. Pac-Man. Students must select three hyperparameters, train the agent, and provide evidence of learning through a README containing GIFs, plots, and evaluation scores.
key_facts: Choose three hyperparameters: exploration, episodes, and learning rate.
Submit one public GitHub repository URL containing the notebook and evidence in its README.
The notebook requires a Python 3.11–3.13 kernel.
Exploration stays constant after 1,000 random warm-up decisions.
An episode ends at game over or the notebook's fixed time limit.
Keep the notebook's evaluation settings unchanged: the same five seeds, 5% exploration, and time limit.
The baseline for comparison is an untrained network, not a random-action agent.
The best GIF is selected from five games and shows at most their first 20 seconds.

concepts.name: Hyperparameters

concepts.name: Fixed Evaluation Protocol
concepts.definition: Measuring a model before and after training under identical, frozen evaluation settings so the comparison is fair.
concepts.in_this_source: The brief requires the same five seeds, 5% exploration, and time limit before and after training, with an untrained network as the baseline.
